site.name: Atelier Vesperia — Studio of Lucia Marciana
site.concept: Portfolio of Lucia Marciana, an architect and mosaicist working in the lineage of Roman imperial geometry, presenting built work, drawings, and commissioned ornament.

card_pattern: Each project card is a travertine-cream rectangle bordered by a single-line Greek-key meander strip at top and bottom. The project title sits in tracked Roman square capitals beneath a small olive-wreath roundel; below it a one-line Latin tag (year, location) in imperial purple, then 2–3 lines of body description. A thin gold-leaf rule separates metadata from description. No drop shadows; the discipline is line, not depth.
design_rules: Travertine-cream ground dominates; ink-black ornament carries the geometry; gold-leaf and Pompeian red appear only as small accents on rules, roundels, and emphasis marks. Every hero is centered on a strict vertical axis and framed by classical geometry — pediment outline or laurel wreath. Headings are Roman square capitals tracked tight; body is generous-leading serif-flavored sans, in long, calm columns.

pages.title: Atelier Vesperia — Studio of Lucia Marciana
pages.content_brief: Full-bleed centered hero: studio name in Roman square capitals beneath an open laurel wreath, tagline 'ARCHITECTURE · MOSAIC · ORNAMENT — ROME, MMXXIV'. Below the hero, three lead projects (Villa Aurelia restoration, Basilica Pavement at Ostia Antica, Domus Hortensia commission) appear as meander-bordered cards. A short studio statement closes the page: four sentences on continuity between Roman geometry and contemporary practice.

pages.title: Selected Works — Atelier Vesperia
pages.content_brief: A chronological catalogue of seven completed works, MMXVI–MMXXIV. Each entry: project title in capitals, client (e.g. 'Soprintendenza Speciale di Roma', 'Fondazione Torlonia'), location, year, and a two-sentence description. Works include the Tabularium Reading Room (Capitoline, 2019), the Mosaic Floor at Villa dei Quintili (2021), and the Tepidarium Pavilion at Bagni di Tivoli (2023). Entries divided by Greek-key strips.

pages.title: Mosaic Pavement, Villa Aurelia — Case Study
pages.content_brief: In-depth case study of the Villa Aurelia pavement restoration on the Janiculum. Sections: 'Site & Findings' (the 1894 excavation record, condition in 2022), 'Geometry' (the rediscovered opus sectile module of 0.382 m), 'Material' (giallo antico, pavonazzetto, bardiglio sources), and 'Method' (lifting, consolidation, reset on lime mortar). Includes a credits panel listing project conservator Dr. Elena Rufina and master mosaicist Tito Vassallo.

pages.title: Drawings & Ornament — Atelier Vesperia
pages.content_brief: A gallery of architectural drawings and ornamental studies offered as commissioned work: ink-and-wash elevations, coffered-ceiling templates, custom Greek-key borders, and laurel-wreath cartouches for private clients. Each plate has a plate number (Tab. I through Tab. XII), a one-line title, and dimensions. Closes with a note that originals are drawn at 1:50 on Fabriano Roma laid paper.

pages.title: Studio & Practice — Lucia Marciana
pages.content_brief: Biographical and practice page. Lucia Marciana, b. 1984 Naples; M.Arch Sapienza Università di Roma 2010; apprenticeship under Paolo Vespasiani 2010–2014; founded Atelier Vesperia 2016. Lists collaborators (structural engineer Marco Ostilio, conservator Elena Rufina), recognitions (Premio Piranesi 2021, shortlist Mies Crown Hall Americas 2023), and teaching at the Accademia di Belle Arti, Roma. Ends with a short credo on axial planning and material restraint.

pages.title: Commissions & Visit — Atelier Vesperia
pages.content_brief: Practical page. Studio address: Via dei Coronari 138, 00186 Roma. Hours by appointment, Tuesday–Friday, 10:00–17:00. Inquiries to studio@vesperia.atelier; commissions handled by atelier manager Flavia Settembrini. A short paragraph clarifies typical commission scope (architectural design from €40,000; bespoke pavement and ornament from €8,000) and a note on lead times of nine to fourteen months.
